title: Phase 5: preserve the open publication for read.p.apyr.us separation
description:
## Current agreed plan — verified 2026-10-17

Ryan's current destination supersedes older papyrus.anth.us/static-only and combined-host plans: p.apyr.us is the public-facing marketing website owned by PRIVATE AnthusAI/Papyrus-web; the open publication remains in PUBLIC AnthusAI/p.apyr.us and moves to read.p.apyr.us. Do not relocate its content, backend, auth or history as part of planning. Existing public marketing/pricing work, including merged PR19 at 30ba4d2 and footer PR18/main 5b29af6, remains intact until a reviewed transition.

Marketing MUST actually use hosted Papyrus CMS/browser editing plus real Markus rendering to S3. Whether hosted editing is needed is resolved: it is required. The marketing CMS hostname is NOT chosen. Public publication reader path on read.p.apyr.us (/information versus /) is unresolved. Current p.apyr.us code still serves marketing /, reader /information and newsroom /newsroom together.

Private marketing CI/CD runs in AWS without GitHub Actions minute dependency; reviewed main merges must deploy without a coding-agent or developer AWS login. Public projects may use GitHub Actions CI with AWS CD. main is default/production; retain develop integration/promotion where established (Papyrus product). No unrelated merge or production main push for this task.

Fresh AWS CLI reads: account 712236451410/us-east-1; marketing Amplify d2scc0rkxkbrhl main auto-build enabled, latest job6 SUCCEED at 35fa30923a9ca591ae97d8901b6447828a14e29a (2026-10-17 13:44:17–13:45:57 UTC). Old job4/18d035e remains historical renderer/S3 proof. Candidate CF E17ZRAI87DN065 is Deployed, S3 origin, no aliases. Publication Amplify ds6yswxui41yi job19 SUCCEED at 5b29af6dc51d15dabbdbeac5f892cb670b7cc143 (14:17:41–14:22:41 UTC). CF E2QW8WOFWQT0H4 and p.apyr.us A/AAAA still point to the combined publication app; no read.p.apyr.us record returned in inspected zone Z0630882HVOV46S7IPV7.

CodePipeline/CodeConnections inventories are empty. Papyrus-web draft PR6, claude/codepipeline-deploy at 7bc8af0, is a separate unmerged/unprovisioned proposal with task papw-9b0d3c2c-68c0-4e4f-8c50-1368ae4e955c. Preserve it; do not mistake its deployment instructions for live infrastructure or approval. Select and prove exactly one publisher before an authorized transition.

Next: choose CMS host/backend/auth binding; prove hosted save/reload/preview/explicit publish through actual Papyrus/Markus/S3 plus private-draft and unauthorized-write denial; decide publication path and inventory redirects/canonical/media links, callbacks/logout/revalidation, TLS/DNS and rollback; separately review delivery proposal; only then propose cutover. Hosted acceptance is not proven by committed-source builds or local mock clients.

Canonical handoff and branch: https://github.com/AnthusAI/Papyrus-web/blob/chore/kanbus-reconciliation-20261016/docs/marketing-publication-handoff.md ; draft PR3 https://github.com/AnthusAI/Papyrus-web/pull/3 extends 25fc542. Its papw records are review-branch work, not main. Product-board plan corrections are Kanbus-only on develop; no develop-to-main promotion is requested. Publication README will expose current-versus-intended mapping in a docs PR.

Scope of this reconciliation: documentation and existing Kanbus records only. No implementation, deployment, DNS, IAM, credentials, deletion or migration. No AWS console browser. Existing local dirty trees and unrelated branches are preserved.

## Earlier plan (historical; current host/ownership requirements above take precedence)

## Goal
p.apyr.us (hostname unchanged) becomes the Papyrus product marketing site at `/`, with today's newspaper ("Information about information systems") moved to `/information`, on the standard pattern proven on Pilobol.us, dogfooded after Threat Intelligence (Phase 4, PPY-332889) and before Anth.us. Pre-production: hard cutover, Git history and the untouched old app are the rollback.

## Decisions (Ryan, 2026-10-07)
1 hostname stays p.apyr.us; 2 marketing at `/`; 3 newspaper at `/information`; 4 `apyr.us` redirects to p.apyr.us and keeps doing so; 5 hard cutover; 6 after Threat Intelligence; 7 follow the Pilobol.us pattern.

## Sub-tasks, in dependency order (label phase-5; estimates in agent-days)
P5-01 readerBasePath in Papyrus (1.5) > P5-02 sync mount and release (1.5) > P5-05 repo scaffold + redirects (1.5) > P5-06 marketing pages (2.5); P5-03 template domain + apex redirect (1) and P5-04 features from packages (3, or 1.5) in parallel; P5-07 new app + fresh backend (1.5) > P5-08 Google sign-in (0.5) > P5-09 data copy and fidelity (2) > P5-10 staging (1.5) > P5-11 cutover (1) > P5-12 retire and docs (1.5). Total about 19.5, critical path about 12.
The assessment and open questions are in the first comment on this ticket.

comments.text:
## Assessment (2026-10-07; read-only AWS, public GETs, origin/develop 4541deb; nothing changed)

### Current state
- App `dbsyytcm9drqa` "Papyrus": WEB_COMPUTE, repo AnthusAI/Papyrus (the product repo itself). Branches: `main` (PRODUCTION, last job 336 SUCCEED 2026-10-05, commit d04b068, 97 commits behind develop) and `codex-rehydration-api-split` (last build FAILED 2026-05-23). Build spec: backend `ampx pipeline-deploy`, frontend `npm run build`. Env var names on main: NEXT_PUBLIC_PAPYRUS_CONSOLE_MODEL, PAPYRUS_CONSOLE_OPENAI_API_KEY_SSM_PARAM, PAPYRUS_CONSOLE_RESPONDER_IMAGE_URI, PAPYRUS_CONTENT_SOURCE, PAPYRUS_EDITION_SLUG, PAPYRUS_ENABLE_CONSOLE_RESPONDER, PAPYRUS_ENABLE_SLACK, PAPYRUS_REVALIDATE_SECRET.
- Domains: association `apyr.us` with subdomains `p` (main) and the apex (main, unverified). The apex redirect is an app custom rule `https://apyr.us` -> `https://p.apyr.us` status 302 (path preserved), plus the 404-200 catch-all. Zone Z10285921B1G7MVRV06W9: apex and `p` A aliases to CloudFront, MX on `p.apyr.us` (SES inbound), ACM validation CNAME. `www.apyr.us` does not resolve.
- Backends: main = stack `amplify-dbsyytcm9drqa-main-branch-cb38ada667` (6 nested groups: auth, data, knowledge vectors, slack consumer, storage, storage backups; 2,372 resources in 98 stacks incl. nested; 24 Lambdas, AppSync, Cognito pool us-east-1_40Uot7WSv with Google IdP, S3 Vectors, SES rule set `papyrus-inbound-p-apyr-us` active, 2 EventBridge rules (15-minute email processor)). codex = stack `...codexrehydrationapisplit-branch-21b76655cb`, 2,318 resources, completely EMPTY (39 tables 0 rows, 0 users).
- Features in use: console responder (container image in ECR), inbound email, Slack agent, storage backups. No scheduled ingestion beyond the email processor. SSM secret names: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET, PAPYRUS_JWT_SECRET, PAPYRUS_SLACK_BOT_TOKEN, PAPYRUS_SLACK_SIGNING_SECRET.
- Live site: `/` 200 but an EMPTY edition ("Page -- of --"), `/2026/october/07` HTTP 500, `/archive` 200, `/newsroom` 200, `/information` 404, `/robots.txt` and `/sitemap.xml` 404 (old main build). Google sign-in is expected broken (Ryan removed the old Cognito URIs from the shared client, 2026-10-05).

### Data to migrate (main backend, scan COUNT)
- IMPORTANT: Item, PublishedItem, Edition, PublishedEdition, EditionItem, Tag, MediaAsset are all 0. There are no published articles; `/information` starts empty (no convert-bodies, no article redirects with real targets).
- Real data = the knowledge corpus and newsroom working state: SemanticNode 771, AssignmentEvent 413, Assignment 395, CategoryKeyword 391, Message 213, Reference 202, KnowledgeImportRun 199, KnowledgeArtifact 175, MessageThread 99, ProcedureRun 75, Category 46, SemanticRelationType 38, ReferenceAttachment 33, NewsroomSection 23, ProcedureDefinition 8, ProcedureVersion 8, KnowledgeCorpus 3, CategorySet 2, SemanticRelation 1; users: UserIdentity 3, UserProfile 2, UserRoleAssignment 3 (Cognito 4 users: 3 Google, 1 confirmed; groups admin 2, editor 4).
- S3 media bucket: 53,183 objects, 10.6 GB (corpora 45,188 / 10.5 GB incl. a misplaced `corpora/pilobol-us/`, newsroom/payloads 7,884, media 75, inbound-email-archived 29, inbound-email 7). S3 Vectors index `papyrus-knowledge`.

### Marketing site (PPY-228e8d)
Branch `feature/PPY-228e8d-papyrus-marketing-site` (worktree PPY-228e8d-marketing), PR #74 CLOSED unmerged, 54 ahead / 244 behind develop, last commit 2026-09-08. Standalone Next 15 static export in `marketing/` (Tailwind 3, Radix/shadcn, components Hero, Newsroom, Ownership, Pricing, Faq, Waitlist, Header, Footer), Gherkin spec, plus S3/CloudFront infra for papyrus.anth.us that we no longer want. Waitlist is design-only. Its pricing (four plans: $0, $100, $20/mo, $100+$20/mo) is NOT the approved ladder (Fork it / Self-setup managed $20/mo / Assisted setup $20/mo + $100 / Professional services). Code should live in the new publication repo as site-owned routes (docs/standard-site.md 1.7), ported, not merged from the old branch.

### Feasibility: one app, `/` marketing, `/information` newspaper
Already works: site-owned files win over generated shims (`app/page.tsx` can be marketing); `rootRoute` kinds; `/newsroom` public path (`newsroomBasePath` = `/newsroom`); Pretext + `/newsroom` co-hosted in one WEB_COMPUTE app (standard-site 1.7); staging gate is prefix-agnostic (exempts only /newsroom, /api, static, robots); Cognito callbacks come from `backend.auth.redirectUrls`.
Missing (evidence on origin/develop):
1. No reader base path anywhere. Hardcoded: `lib/edition-routes.ts` (`getEditionDatePath` returns `/YYYY/<month>/DD`, `getCurrentDatePath`), `components/newspaper.tsx:1880`, `lib/newspaper-layout.ts:899`, `lib/presentation-footer.ts:46`, `lib/papyrus-web-locations.ts:60,66,219,452`, `components/settings-page.tsx:117`, `lib/archive-data.ts`, `app/api/revalidate/route.ts:38-48,79`. -> P5-01.
2. `papyrus-app sync` (`packages/papyrus/src/sync.mjs`) cannot relocate or omit routes; it would leave `/[year]/...`, `/articles`, `/archive` at the root. -> P5-02.
3. `lib/newsroom-base-path.ts` supports only `/newsroom` or `""`, so the newsroom must stay at `/newsroom` (`/information/newsroom` would need deeper changes; not recommended).
4. Template: no redirect rules (apex apyr.us), domain/MX coexistence unproven. -> P5-03 (with TI PPY-4f2519).
5. Features from packages unproven: standard-site section 5 notes console-responder image, SES, Slack, backups not done; account-global names collide with the old backend. -> P5-04.
6. No sitemap exists; robots/noindex logic is global and fine. Canonical metadata for marketing is set in the page itself. Staging session cookie scope across `/` and `/information` unverified (probed in P5-10).
Marketing CSS risk: the shared root layout loads Tailwind 4 and a 9,000-line `globals.css`; marketing's Tailwind 3 theme must be scoped (fallback: static export under `public/` with a middleware rewrite of `/`).

### Recommended architecture
ONE new repo `AnthusAI/p.apyr.us` on `@anthusai/papyrus` (+ papyrus-newsroom), ONE new repo-less WEB_COMPUTE app from the CDK template with a FRESH backend (not reconnecting dbsyytcm9drqa: the console connect flow was seen to delete branches and env vars, and deleting a Gen2 branch can delete its data stack; the old app stays untouched as the rollback). Marketing = site-owned `app/page.tsx` + components; newspaper = reader routes mounted at `/information` via `readerBasePath`; `/newsroom` unchanged. Legacy paths redirect through `next.config` `redirects()`; apex redirect through `site.json`.

### Redirect plan
Permanent (301/308): `/YYYY/<month>/DD[...]` -> `/information/YYYY/<month>/DD[...]`, `/articles/<slug>` -> `/information/articles/<slug>`, `/archive` and `/settings` likewise. `/` is marketing (no redirect), `/newsroom` and `/api` unchanged. `apyr.us/*` -> `https://p.apyr.us/*` (upgrade 302 to 301 unless Ryan wants it temporary). papyrus.anth.us (serves 200 today, not investigated) -> p.apyr.us at cutover (Q8). Note: no real article exists, so the legacy rules protect only empty/placeholder URLs; they are cheap and specified.

### Risks
Empty newspaper at launch; feature migration (SES single active rule set and MX, Slack URL, console responder image, S3 Vectors index); 10 unverified-domain limit on the shared Google client; editing freeze during copy; Python 3.12 on the Amplify image; CSS isolation of marketing; TI template changes (PPY-4f2519, PPY-301b12 copy tool) are prerequisites we reuse.

### Ticket map (children of this ticket, label phase-5)
P5-01 PPY-f1f695 readerBasePath | P5-02 PPY-aa4daf sync mount + release | P5-03 PPY-10b794 template domain/apex redirect | P5-04 PPY-e186e5 features from packages | P5-05 PPY-b10562 repo scaffold + redirects | P5-06 PPY-b35203 marketing pages | P5-07 PPY-aa93b3 new app + backend | P5-08 PPY-d0b746 Google sign-in | P5-09 PPY-e20cab data copy + fidelity | P5-10 PPY-794ecb staging | P5-11 PPY-52d455 cutover | P5-12 PPY-343fea retire + docs.
Order: 01 > 02 > 05 > 06; 03 and 04 parallel; 07 needs 02, 03, 05 (and the TI template tickets PPY-4f2519, PPY-153434); 08 > 09 (needs TI copy tool PPY-301b12) > 10 > 11 > 12 (7 days after 11). Phase numbering: this ticket was the placeholder Phase 4; TI took Phase 4 (PPY-332889), so this is Phase 5 (retitled, same ticket reused).

### Moments Ryan is needed
M1 SSO login + yes to the stack deploy (P5-07); M2 repo creation, GitHub App console sitting, staging branch (P5-05, P5-07, P5-10); M3 Google client URIs, secrets, first sign-in (P5-08); M4 yes to data apply, editing freeze (P5-09); M5 visual/copy approval of marketing, PR merges (P5-01, 02, 03, 05, 06); M6 yes to domain, SES, Slack steps and go/no-go (P5-11); M7 yes to every deletion (P5-12).

### Open questions for Ryan
Q1 Newsroom URL: keep `/newsroom` (recommended) or `/information/newsroom`?
Q2 The newspaper has 0 published articles and a 500 on its dated page: launch `/information` empty (with placeholder furniture), or seed it first?
Q3 Keep the current newsprint layout and masthead for `/information`, or the Pretext blog layout planned in standard-site?
Q4 Which features stay: inbound email, backups, Slack, console responder? (Recommended: keep email + backups; drop Slack and console responder unless used.)
Q5 Waitlist form: stay design-only, or wire to email/contact?
Q6 Users: re-sign-in and re-assign roles for the 3 people (recommended) instead of remapping Cognito subjects?
Q7 `corpora/pilobol-us/` in the old media bucket: skip (recommended) or copy to the Pilobol.us backend?
Q8 papyrus.anth.us: redirect to p.apyr.us in this phase, and which host serves it today?
Q9 Apex redirect status: 301 (recommended) or keep 302?
Q10 Repo name `AnthusAI/p.apyr.us` and public visibility OK?

comments.text: DECISIONS (Ryan, 2026-10-07): hostname stays p.apyr.us; marketing at /, newspaper at /information; apyr.us keeps redirecting to p.apyr.us; hard cutover, pre-production. Defaults accepted: 1 newsroom stays at /newsroom. 2 launch /information empty (0 published articles today), seed later. 3 keep the current newsprint layout and masthead. 4 keep inbound email and backups; drop Slack and the console responder. 5 waitlist form stays design-only. 6 re-sign-in with Google and role reassignment for the 3 users is fine. 7 skip corpora/pilobol-us in the old media bucket. 8 redirect papyrus.anth.us at cutover (find out first which host serves it). 9 apex redirect is a 301. 10 repo AnthusAI/p.apyr.us, public. Order: Threat Intelligence (Phase 4) first; P5 reuses its copy tool and template pieces.
